mapper.select:
select cs.id, cs.resident_id, cs.resident_name, cs.team_id, cs.package_id, cs.sign_date, cs.start_date, cs.end_date, cs.contract_status, cs.sign_type, cs.create_by, cs.create_time, cs.update_by, cs.update_time, cs.remark, ra.gender as ra_gender, ra.age as ra_age, ra.id_card as ra_id_card, ra.phone as ra_phone, ra.managing_institution as ra_managing_institution, ra.managing_doctor as ra_managing_doctor, ra.disease_types as ra_disease_types, ct.team_name as ct_team_name, cp.package_name as cp_package_name, cp.price as cp_price, mp.person_name as mp_person_name, mp.gender_source_value as mp_gender_source_value, mp.phone_number as mp_phone_number, mp.sex as mp_sex from contract_sign cs left join resident_archive ra on cs.resident_id = ra.id left join ( select card_id, max(person_id) as person_id from mp_person group by card_id ) m on m.card_id = ra.id_card left join mp_person mp on mp.person_id = m.person_id left join contract_team ct on cs.team_id = ct.id left join contract_package cp on cs.package_id = cp.id
and (mp.person_name like concat('%', #{residentName}, '%') or cs.resident_name like concat('%', #{residentName}, '%')) and cs.contract_status = #{contractStatus} and cs.sign_type like concat('%', #{signType}, '%') and cs.sign_date >= #{beginSignDate} and cs.sign_date <= #{endSignDate} and cs.team_id = #{teamId} and ra.managing_institution like concat('%', #{managingInstitution}, '%') and ra.managing_doctor like concat('%', #{managingDoctor}, '%') and ra.disease_types like concat('%', #{diseaseTypes}, '%')
order by cs.id desc

select cs.id, cs.resident_id, cs.resident_name, cs.team_id, cs.package_id, cs.sign_date, cs.start_date, cs.end_date, cs.contract_status, cs.sign_type, cs.create_by, cs.create_time, cs.update_by, cs.update_time, cs.remark, ra.gender as ra_gender, ra.age as ra_age, ra.id_card as ra_id_card, ra.phone as ra_phone, ra.managing_institution as ra_managing_institution, ra.managing_doctor as ra_managing_doctor, ra.disease_types as ra_disease_types, ct.team_name as ct_team_name, cp.package_name as cp_package_name, cp.price as cp_price, mp.person_name as mp_person_name, mp.gender_source_value as mp_gender_source_value, mp.phone_number as mp_phone_number, mp.sex as mp_sex from contract_sign cs left join resident_archive ra on cs.resident_id = ra.id left join ( select card_id, max(person_id) as person_id from mp_person group by card_id ) m on m.card_id = ra.id_card left join mp_person mp on mp.person_id = m.person_id left join contract_team ct on cs.team_id = ct.id left join contract_package cp on cs.package_id = cp.id where cs.id = #{id}
